info.title: Fenergo Nebula Localisation Command
info.description:
**Localisation Command API**:
Localisation Command API provides both configurational and operational methods related to the client localisations. Use the Localisation Command API to create and update new and existing localisations and versions. Use the Query API to retrieve localisations and aggregates.
**Localisation Command API provides**:
  • The ability to create, update and delete Localisations.
  • The ability to manage versions of Localisations - Including creating new versions, archiving existing versions, submiting drafts for approval and signing or rejecting versions.
